notes: Modified cash basis. Governmental receipts/disbursements from Total Governmental Funds column (p6); transfers in 1,803,121 is the Total column after the reclassification column (p7). Business-type from Total Proprietary Funds column (p10-11, includes internal service fund, ties to government-wide). The proprietary cash-flow schedule (p15) is partial and the basis is modified cash, so proprietary is null. Balance sheet from government-wide Statement of Net Position (capital assets and debt included). Detail: governmental per fund column from p6-7 (All-Purpose Fund budget schedule p12 is a combined all-funds schedule, not recorded); enterprise detail from the accrual-basis departmental combining schedule (p13-14), which is on a different basis than the modified cash statement (e.g. operating revenues 4,968,845 vs 4,944,770), so it does not tie to the statement. Read pages 1-15 of 15.
